description: Renovate owns dependency updates for this repo; Dependabot only reports alerts.
Non-major updates auto-merge once CI passes. A merge here only builds a new meowbot image that rolls to non; prd stays pinned in dotablaze-tech/deployments.

packageRules.description: Go modules and the meowbot base image ship in the bot, so they commit as fix(deps): @jscutlery/semver only cuts a release for fix and feat, and a chore(deps) security patch would merge without ever deploying. They get their own group because one group produces one commit, which carries one type.
Nx majors need nx migrate and their generated migrations, so they never auto-merge, even though they are devDependencies.
